# External memory-system baselines, pinned for reproducibility (paper table).
# Install in a dedicated external-baseline environment. MemoryOS currently
# requires Transformers 4.x, while the maintained ASK ML extra uses the audited
# Transformers 5.x line. Do not combine the two environments.
#   python3.12 -m venv .venv-external
#   .venv-external/bin/python -m pip install -r external/requirements-external.txt

# Mem0 (Chhikara et al., 2025)
mem0ai==2.0.11
qdrant-client>=1.9
sentence-transformers>=3.0

# Zep/Graphiti (Rasmussen et al., 2025), FalkorDB service backend
# The adapter imports FalkorDriver, so the FalkorDB extra is required; Kuzu
# alone cannot satisfy this runner.
graphiti-core[falkordb]==0.29.2

# Letta / MemGPT (Packer et al., 2023), client only; server runs in Docker
letta-client==1.12.1

# MemOS (Li et al., 2025)
MemoryOS==2.0.23
transformers==4.57.6
chonkie==1.7.0
langchain-text-splitters==1.1.2
